pro_description.value: When you make an unarmed or weapon attack roll to hit a creature, but before you roll to hit, you can choose to infuse your attack with a rush of manipulated blood. If the attack hits, this attack deals additional damage (slashing, bludgeoning or piercing, your choice) equal to half the Cost paid.

con_description.value: Cost: However much you want to give. (Maximum: 10 x your level).
